title: Project Shockwave
subtitle: Hybrid Immersive Audio Engineering Platform
tagline: Engineering cinematic audio experiences for everyone.
mission: Engineer an affordable cinematic audio platform using off-the-shelf hardware.
problem: Commercial systems are expensive. Many middle-class families cannot justify premium home theater pricing.
objective: Deliver premium room-filling audio using intelligent engineering instead of expensive branded ecosystems.

challenges.title: Room acoustics
challenges.problem: Reflections and standing waves can make an affordable system feel uneven.
challenges.analysis: Map surfaces, listening position and bass accumulation before choosing placement.
challenges.solution: Use symmetry, toe-in, listening-zone mapping and calibration passes.
challenges.result: A wider, more even listening field without expensive acoustic treatment.

challenges.title: Cable routing
challenges.problem: A living room cannot feel like a wiring closet.
challenges.analysis: Signal and power paths need to be serviceable but invisible.
challenges.solution: Plan the route before installation and separate signal from power runs.
challenges.result: Clean installation with lower noise risk and easier maintenance.

challenges.title: Power budget
challenges.problem: More channels do not automatically mean more usable headroom.
challenges.analysis: Match amplifier behavior, speaker efficiency and realistic listening levels.
challenges.solution: Size the system around the room and leave measured headroom.
challenges.result: Punchy dynamics without wasteful or unsafe over-specification.

challenges.title: Component compatibility
challenges.problem: Affordable hardware often speaks different signal languages.
challenges.analysis: Trace every connector, format and conversion point.
challenges.solution: Use an intentional splitter and validate each hand-off.
challenges.result: Reliable source-to-speaker playback with minimal latency.
